description: Department of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - Order to designate the Urani lagoon and the Kottakal Lagoon as a Fisheries Management Area
categorisation: The gazette content primarily consists of detailed land survey coordinates and boundary descriptions for a specific area in the Eastern Province (Kandawala - Sri Lanka National Grid reference). It deals with land registration, property boundaries, and land title matters, which fall squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). While there is a brief reference to government authority, the core content is exclusively about land/property delineation without any government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
